author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN009000195 (PTHR12682)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel Archease (FBgn0289108) and orthologs

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Erroneous source

This node is annotated with "protein guanylyltransferase activity(CONTRIBUTES_TO)" based on (HUMAN|HGNC=24094|UniProtKB=Q8IWT0;)

That annotation comes from PMID:38493148. Interesting, there are three annotations to Q8IWT0 from that paper:
 "protein guanylyltransferase activity(CONTRIBUTES_TO)" by NUNI
 "protein guanylyltransferase activity(ENABLES)" by NUNI
 "RNA ligase (GTP) activity(CONTRIBUTES_TO)" by SWIS

Of those, I think the SWIS annotation is the most accurate/appropriate. I don't know what group 'NUNI' refers to, but I think those annotations should be removed. @pgaudet who is NUNI?
title: PAINT issue: PTN009000195 (PTHR12682)

author: marcfeuermann
body: NUNI is Noctua annotation (for GO-CAM), this means that the GO-CAM model has to be reviewed. I've transmitted the request to the person who made these annotations. On my side I've changed the PAINT annotation to "RNA ligase (GTP) activity(CONTRIBUTES_TO)"

author: marcfeuermann
body: After discussion with @lbreuza this might be checked again.

author: lbreuza
body:
Hi,
@sjm41 , I created all 3 annotations as NUNIs is the import of standard annotations from GO-CAM models curated by UniProt (in this case 2 models I curated). There is a flow in the way I built them. I have to update the GO-CAMs.
Q8IWT0/ archease enables a protein guanylyltransferase activity and activates RTCB within the complex through the guanylylation of RTCB at its active site histidine, forming a covalent GMP-histidine intermediate. It is RTCB that has a RNA ligase (GTP) activity.

So I would like to change my annotations so that:
Archease enables a protein guanylyltransferase activity 
RTCB enables RNA ligase (GTP) activity

Before I go for it I wanted to be sure we agree on this.
Best, Lionel

author: sjm41
body:
Hi @lbreuza 
My main concerns/confusion here was that Q8IWT0/ archease had been annotated with two different MFs from the same paper, and that one of those (protein guanylyltransferase activity) had 2 different qualifiers (enabled & contributes to)!
Changing the Q8IWT0/ archease annotation to the single "enables protein guanylyltransferase activity" annotation works for me.
Thanks!

author: marcfeuermann
body: Thanks a lot to both for this clarification . I will adapt the PAINT annotation accordingly. Now I can close this :-)
